en: This island is where I was born. If anything happened to it, or to the Pokémon that live here, I'd never forgive myself.
I heard you set free the Pokémon in Team Rocket's warehouse. Thank you, {player}. The island owes you a great deal.
Before long I'll go back to the Pokémon League. When you come to challenge it, I'll be waiting, colder than ever.
For now I'll do what I can for the island. The League can spare me a little while longer.
A Pokémon doll, plump and soft. There are dolls everywhere in this house!
